question: Related Questions Q. Is it allowed to make entry in share market (Satta Bazaar) according to islam? Plz explain. 10594 views Q. I am a SEBI Registered Stock Broker I have more than 50 customers buying & selling shares through me. I do know there are conditions applied as per Sharia for buying & selling shares, but not all of my customers follow them. Very few follow these conditions rests of all are involved into all types of trading which are haram as per Sharia. My earning is based on the brokerage charged to clients by BSE & NSE. That means I am paid brokerage (Commissions) from the NSE & BSE. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Shares & Investments Question ID: 4755 Country: India Title: I am trading in share market, I want to know that if i sold shares in the morning after market starts and buy shares (which i sold in the morning or before some time) after some time in that day before closing the market, which is called short position/transaction, is it HALAL or HARAM? Question: I am trading in share market, I want to know that if i sold shares in the morning after market starts and buy shares (which i sold in the morning or before some time) after some time in that day before closing the market, which is called short position/transaction, is it HALAL or HARAM? Answer ID: 4755 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1538/1172=H/1429) If the shares take some day?s time to covert to freeze assets, it is unlawful to sell the shares before that, rather is ir haram . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
